_comment: OmniLink device-config schema. SOURCED from ExpressLRS firmware src/python/binary_configurator.py (binary-patch options) + build_flags.py (compile-time defines). Modern ELRS 3.0+ patches these as a JSON options block into a PRE-BUILT binary — no compilation needed for the common case. Compile-from-source is only required for custom/unlisted targets or the build-flag-only options. This file IS the data-driven source for FR-FLASH-03 (structured form) and FR-WIZ-03 (plain-English wizard). help/label text is OmniLink's value-add — extend freely. Verify defaults against the firmware version in use; values here track ELRS master as of June 2026.

mechanisms.binary_patch: Common config written into a flashed/pre-built binary via the ELRS options block. No compile. Covers the 'binding','regulatory','telemetry','wifi','link','fc' groups below.
mechanisms.compile_flag: Requires compile-from-source (PlatformIO). Covers the 'build_only' group. Triggered only when user changes one of those, or selects an unlisted custom target.

binding_phrase.label: Binding phrase
binding_phrase.help: A secret word/phrase shared between TX and RX so they bind to each other and ignore other links. MD5-hashed into a 6-byte UID. SENSITIVE — never sent to the AI API (FR-AI-06/NFR-PRIV-01).

uid.label: UID (advanced)
uid.help: Raw 6-byte binding UID. Normally derived from the binding phrase; only set directly if you know the exact UID.

lock_on_first_connection.label: Lock RF mode on first connection
lock_on_first_connection.help: After the link is established, lock the RF mode so it won't drop to a slower/longer-range rate mid-flight. Recommended ON for most pilots.

domain.label: Regulatory domain
domain.help: Legal RF band/power rules for your country. Only applies to SX127x (900MHz/sub-GHz) hardware; 2.4GHz (SX128x) ignores it. Flashing the wrong domain can be illegal and reduce range.

tlm_report_interval_ms.label: Telemetry report interval
tlm_report_interval_ms.help: Minimum time between telemetry packets sent down from the RX. Lower = fresher telemetry but slightly less link bandwidth for control. 240ms is the ELRS default.

home_ssid.label: Home WiFi SSID
home_ssid.help: Optional. If set, the device auto-joins this network in WiFi mode instead of starting its own access point — convenient for OTA updates at the bench.

home_password.label: Home WiFi password
home_password.help: Password for the Home WiFi SSID above. Stored on the device; treated as sensitive by OmniLink.

auto_wifi_interval_s.label: Auto-WiFi timeout
auto_wifi_interval_s.help: If the device can't establish a radio link within this many seconds of power-on, it automatically starts WiFi mode (handy for recovering a misconfigured RX). Leave unset to disable.

rx_baud.label: RX↔FC baud rate
rx_baud.help: Serial speed between the receiver and the flight controller (Betaflight/iNav). 420000 is the standard CRSF rate; only change if your FC UART can't handle it.

airport_baud.label: AirPort baud rate
airport_baud.help: Only for AirPort (serial-bridge) builds — the baud rate of the transparent serial link. Leave unset unless you specifically use AirPort.

link.label: Link / model
link._note: Profile-facing link tunables that map to a ProfileSettings key (M54). Safe entries (model_match, telemetry_ratio) are AI-suggestable through the M54 closed allowlist; tx_power is RF output power and is safety_critical → never AI-suggestable.

model_match.label: Model match
model_match.help: When on, the RX only accepts control from a TX broadcasting the matching model id, so you can't fly the wrong model's rates. Non-safety-critical convenience toggle.

telemetry_ratio.label: Telemetry ratio
telemetry_ratio.help: How often a downlink telemetry packet takes an uplink slot. Higher ratios give fresher telemetry at a small cost to control bandwidth. Non-safety-critical.

tx_power.label: TX power
tx_power.help: RF output power in milliwatts. Regulatory- and thermal-critical: raising it can exceed legal limits and overheat the module. SAFETY-CRITICAL — never AI-suggestable (excluded from the M54 allowlist).

backpack.label: Backpack
backpack._note: ExpressLRS Backpack (TX-side telemetry/control bridge + VRX-side video companion) settings, FR-FLASH-11c. All binary-patchable into the pre-built Backpack binary — no compile.

vtx_channel.label: VTX channel
vtx_channel.help: The video transmitter band + channel the Backpack tunes to (40-channel raceband set: A/B/E/F/R bands, channels 1-8). R1 (Raceband 1) is a common default. Must match your goggles/receiver.

dvr_control.label: DVR recording trigger
dvr_control.help: When the Backpack tells the goggles' DVR to record: 'off' never auto-records, 'armed' starts/stops with the craft arm/disarm state, 'manual' leaves recording fully under your control.

head_tracker.label: Head tracking
head_tracker.help: Enable forwarding of goggle head-tracker pan/tilt/roll data over the Backpack link to drive a gimbal. Leave off unless you have a head-tracking setup.

build_only.label: Advanced (requires compile-from-source)
build_only._note: Changing any of these forces the compile path (Decision #3 Hybrid engine). Sourced from build_flags.py.

unlock_higher_power.label: Unlock higher power
unlock_higher_power.help: Removes the firmware power cap on hardware that supports more output than the default limit. Advanced — higher power draws more current/heat and may exceed legal limits. Compile-time only.

fan_min_runtime_s.label: Fan minimum runtime
fan_min_runtime_s.help: On TX modules with a cooling fan, the minimum time the fan keeps running once it turns on. Prevents rapid on/off cycling.

flash_methods._comment: ELRS UploadMethod enum (binary_flash.py). Maps to FR-FLASH-09 transports.
flash_methods.bf: Betaflight passthrough via FC (FR-FLASH-09a MSP passthrough)
